# Alejandro Martínez-Mingo — academic website

Official personal academic website of Alejandro Martínez-Mingo, Profesor Ayudante Doctor at Universidad Nacional de Educación a Distancia (UNED), Faculty of Psychology, Department of Behavioral Sciences Methodology.

Research: cognitive psychology; language and conceptual representation; computational models of cognition; semantic subspaces and geometry; quantum-inspired cognitive models; language models and construct validity; behavioral science methodology.
